artboards.title: Action — Redirect / Replace query / Remove word / Replace word

annotations.text: Panel anatomy — stock SidePanel (size Stackable, 760px, radius 16): headline 24/32 with a one-line muted subtitle, close icon top right (tooltip “Discard”). Body sections 24px apart, separated by a stock Divider; footer = Discard (secondary) and Apply (primary) right-aligned, 12px apart. Esc, the X and a click outside all discard; Apply writes back to the card only — the page’s Save rule persists.

Switch-section pattern (condition panel) — a stock Switch (size M) heads each section: Query / Filters / Context. Its fields sit 48px in under the switch, rows of stock Select + Input with 8px gaps and 16px between rows. A section that is off shows only its switch. Only one condition card may have Query on and one Context on; the page refuses a second.

Item picker (Pin / Hide / Boost / Bury) — stock Input (“Find the item”) over our own list markup: bordered 8px rows, title 14 over url 12 muted, selected row lilac #e0dcff + 600. Under the list a muted status line (Searching… / N matches. / No matches. Try fewer words.) and a quinary “Details” that reveals the stored id. A chosen item reads “Selected: title url”; one the index lost shows its id with a yellow Tag.

Attribute rows (condition Filters, Filter results, Boost / Bury “matching”) — per row a stock Select (attribute; facetable fields of the index) · “is” · stock Select of real index values with counts, or a stock Input when the attribute is not facetable · quinary Remove. Under the rows: tertiary Add row + quinary Edit as text, which swaps the rows for one Input “Expression” and a Back to rows button.

Component map — SidePanel (frame, headline, footer) · Switch (section heads, Match plurals & synonyms) · Select (operator, attribute, value, contact group, language) · Input (words, expression, position, multiplier, word, …with, search instead for, send the visitor to, picker search) · TextArea (JSON, monospace) · Button (Discard secondary, Apply primary, Add row tertiary, Remove / Edit as text / Back to rows / Details quinary) · Tag (yellow “no longer in the index”) · Spinner (Searching…) · Divider between sections. Own markup only: the picker result list and the dashed add areas on the page.
